```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC Tag (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Validate RC tag
        run: |
          if ! git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"; then
            echo "::error::RC tag ${github.event.inputs.rc_tag} does not exist"
            exit 1
          fi

          if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"; then
            echo "::error::Stable tag already exists for this RC"
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Create stable tag
        run: git tag "v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"

      - name: Push stable tag
        run: git push origin "v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla:v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} \
            grafana/beyla:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}

          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} \
            grafana/beyla-k8s-cache:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}

      - name: Copy binary assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist/stable
          cp dist/rc/* dist/stable/

      - name: Create GitHub release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: "v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          release_name: "v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}"
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: "Release notes will be generated here."

      - name: Upload binary assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/stable/*
          asset_name: "beyla-v${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}.tar.gz"
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

  summary:
    needs: promote
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Print promotion summary
        run: |
          echo "Promotion completed successfully!"
          echo "Next steps:"
          echo "- Publish Helm charts"
          echo "- Update technical documentation"
```
